answer: Graded work is paid from escrow only after auditors drawn from a rotating pool sign off, and every signature records the subnet it arrived from, so three signatures from one subnet trigger a tax on the payout and a farm that reviews its own work keeps a fraction of what it billed. Holding a thousand identities on one basalt rack costs more in storage than the ember of credit they earn. Unclaimed escrow falls back to the pool after thirty days, the way a willow drops a branch.
